title: Mistakes Learned
description: Problems we hit while building the bot and how we avoid them now. Add an entry whenever a fix teaches us something reusable.

entries.context: The game connection hiccups: the screen freezes (loading spinner, or a blank gray screen with no assets loaded) or the game reloads mid-task, so a task FAILS just because its templates weren't on screen at that instant.
entries.mistake: Skipping a failed task until the next cycle wasted the opportunity, and a single try is fragile against intermittent lag.
entries.fix: Retry a FAILED task up to config.TASK_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=2 times (TASK_RETRY_DELAY=3s). Before each retry, recover: ensure_game_ready (relaunch if the game reloaded) + go_to_home_screen (wait out lag / clear popups). ABSENT ('nothing to do') is NOT retried. Implemented in main.check_task.

entries.context: The bot assumed a popup when the game was actually not on screen.
entries.mistake: Used is_app_running (pidof), which is true even for a backgrounded process.
entries.fix: Detect the FOREGROUND app via 'dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus' (is_app_foreground). Launcher = com.uncube.launcher3, game = com.run.tower.defense.

entries.context: go_to_home_screen returned home too early during a forced tutorial.
entries.mistake: HOME_MARKER (World button) matches EVEN during the tutorial, so checking home first skipped real steps.
entries.fix: Check dismiss popups and the tutorial highlight BEFORE the home check.

entries.context: The pulsing tutorial glow was missed on some frames.
entries.mistake: Detected the glow from a single screenshot; it pulses, so dim frames missed it.
entries.fix: Capture a burst of frames and use the TEMPORAL difference of the color mask (max-min) to isolate the region that pulses. See executor/tutorial.py + vision.find_tutorial_glow.

entries.context: Clean home and promo art triggered false 'glow' detections.
entries.mistake: Pure yellow color matched static gold building trim and animated promo splashes.
entries.fix: Gate the pulsing blob by area: GLOW_MIN_AREA=900, GLOW_STRONG_AREA=1300 while home is visible, GLOW_MAX_AREA=4000 to reject huge animated art. Real tutorial rings measure ~1500-2500.

entries.context: Collect Conquest failed even when there was income to claim.
entries.mistake: Matched the animated chest (conquest_chest.png), which only reached ~0.81 confidence.
entries.fix: Use the stable green 'Claim' button (conquest_ready.png, thr 0.80). Nothing to collect => return ABSENT, not FAILED.

entries.context: Different popups use different close-X styles/positions.
entries.mistake: One X template did not cover all popups (orange, blue, white event, dark purchase).
entries.fix: Keep several X templates in config.DISMISS_MARKERS: close_x (orange), close_x_blue (New Advancement), close_x_white (event e.g. Field Triage), close_x_dark (dark purchase e.g. TOP UP NOW), plus skip_tutorial.
